scope: Small synthetic integration of the inspected pinned detector and estimator modules plus inspected proposed p-value-quarantine detector text; no full upstream pipeline
local_adapters: Gaussian right-tail helper implemented locally with erfc; not execution of upstream pvalues.py
datasets: One deterministic fixture: 3 runs × 2 agents × 8 ordered rounds, yielding 3 run pairs with 16 rows and 20 concatenated dimensions each
tests: AST inspection of pinned source hashes and source patch preserves all estimate_mi calls and RNG-call expressions
Run original/patched detector with a deterministic spy estimator; compare complete joint/reference input hashes and estimator arguments across all 3 run pairs
Run original/patched detector with actual inspected upstream estimator; compare all pre-existing details, raw statistic, MI values, DV/NWJ values exactly
Verify proposed patch sets p_value=1 and unavailable status only in the intended DV branch
Constructed MI-only spy case changes standard-Holm consumer decision; no real ROC or production consumer execution
Four zero-fit edgecase calls: original/patched insufficient-runs and no-pairs outputs exactly match; no added estimator calls
not_established_even_if_passes: Feature extraction correctness on real transcripts
Operational calibration, FPR, power, real ROC or full adaptive pipeline
execution_guards: BLAS thread environment enforced to 1 before NumPy import and recorded; reject preimported NumPy
Exclusive started marker; reject any existing start/result/failure marker
Compile and execute only immutable source bytes verified against fixed SHA256 values; never load external pyc caches
Runtime counters cap and assert 30 actual estimator calls and 4560 training steps
Assert old p_value equals patched details.uncalibrated_tail_score and all quarantine status/policy/reference fields in both spy and numeric phases
stopping_condition: One complete bounded run in a fresh empty output directory; record exceptions/timeouts/nonfinite outputs/mismatches as failure; no automatic retry.
